producer_report.summary:
Added the Jev client and a fake. Introspection now asks Jev the failure-class and is-repeat questions in shadow and records both answers. fmt, clippy (-D warnings) and the full `cargo test --locked` pass with no network. Nothing was run live: the real endpoint, the reply's answers key and the cost figure are unchecked.

- **Client (`crates/athena-core/src/jev.rs`):** POSTs to `/v1/evaluate` only, with `{model:'typesafe-ai/jev', state, questions}` and several questions per call. It parses choice answers (choice, probabilities, confidence), boolean answers (the probability alone, no value field), usage, and the cost string as a number.
- **Errors and retries:** The chat-endpoint refusal ("a decision model, not a language model") is a build error and is not retried. Auth and other 4xx errors are not retried. Only 500/502/503/504, timeouts and connection resets retry.
- **Key:** It is read only from `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`, prints as `<key>`, and is scrubbed from error text. A test asserts it is absent from Debug and error output.
- **Outbound wrapper (`gh.rs`):** It had no HTTP transport and the workspace has no HTTP crate. I added an `HttpPost` trait and `CurlHttp`, which runs the installed `curl` program, and made the retry loop callable on its own (`retry_transient`). The key goes to `curl` on stdin, not in its arguments. I did not add a crate because none could be fetched here. The external-calls guard still passes; it only allows HTTP inside `gh.rs`. This choice is recorded as D92 in `docs/decisions.md`. `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock` are unchanged.
- **Fake:** `FakeJev` returns the same typed reply, takes a script of results, and logs its calls. It is the only Jev used outside the ignored live test `live_jev_answers_both_question_kinds`.
- **Shadow wiring:**
  - `Athena` has a new field `jev: Option<Box<dyn Evaluate>>`. The command line sets the real client only when `ATHENA_JEV_SHADOW=1`; tests set the fake.
  - The introspection step sends the same prompt text the model sees and puts both questions in one call.
  - The answers, usage and cost go into a new optional `jev` field on the introspection record. A failed call is stored as an error and blocks nothing. `from_jev` stays false.
  - `athena status` shows the answers.
- **Records:** Records with Jev answers validate. Older records without the field still parse; a test checks this.
- **Tests:** Fake-based tests cover choice, boolean, multi-question, error and shadow-recording paths. They include a test where Jev disagrees with the model and the recorded class stays the model's, and one where Jev fails and the job outcome is unchanged.
- **Docs:** Section 12 step 5 in `docs/design/defaults-loop.md` is marked built, with what was and was not checked live. `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry.

checks_run.note: Run again after a type-alias fix for clippy's complex-type lint.
All suites pass, including the new jev unit tests, the four new shadow tests in crates/athena-cli/tests/introspection.rs, and external_calls_guard. The live test is ignored.

open_issues: Nothing was checked live. The reply's key for the answers (`answers`, with `results` accepted) is an assumption, not a probed fact.
The cost of about $0.00002 a call is an estimate from the probes. Proxy authentication and the real call are untested; the ignored live test is the check to run.
CurlHttp needs the `curl` program and parses its stdout status line. Swapping it for a crate-backed HttpPost is cheap if wanted.
Expected deliverables Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and crates/athena-core/Cargo.toml are unchanged, because no new crate was added.
Scoring Jev's recorded answers, and the host-error and landing triggers, remain out of scope and unbuilt.
mistakes: I first wrote a forbidden boundary-scan word in the section 12 text. I caught it and removed it, then grepped every changed file for the forbidden words: none remain.
I first named a test helper `client` and reused it after a local of the same name shadowed it. I fixed it before compiling (the Debug test now binds `shown`).
I used the name `Answer` in introspect.rs, where it already existed. That broke the build until I imported the Jev one as `JevAnswer`.
learnings: The workspace has no HTTP crate. external_calls_guard.rs forbids HTTP-client words (including the bare word `curl`) in any .rs or Cargo.toml under crates/ except gh.rs, so all outbound code must live in gh.rs.
`Athena` is built as a struct literal in five places (core test helper, CLI tests common/mod.rs, two in wiring.rs, run_pin_tests.rs), so a new field means editing each of them.
`IntrospectionRecord` uses deny_unknown_fields, so the new field needed serde(default) to keep older records parsing; skip_serializing_if keeps their JSON unchanged.
Bash allows only cargo, git, ls, chmod, mv and rm. sed, tail and similar are denied, so edits go through the Edit tool.
desires: A way to read or fetch crates offline, so a maintained HTTP crate could have been chosen instead of the curl program.
A recorded live response from /v1/evaluate, to confirm the key that holds the answers.
